collectFeeMode.solOnly: All swap fees are collected as SOL. Simpler to manage — one asset to claim.
collectFeeMode.compounding: A percentage of swap fees are automatically reinvested back into the pool, growing your liquidity position over time. The remaining fees are claimable as SOL.

definitions.compoundingPercent: The percentage of swap fees that get reinvested into the pool. Only applies to compounding fee mode. At 50%, half the fees grow your position and half are claimable. At 100%, all fees compound — nothing to claim until you exit.
definitions.dynamicFee: When enabled, swap fees increase during high volatility and decrease during calm periods. Protects liquidity providers from arbitrage during price spikes. Acts as an anti-sniper mechanism — bots pay more during volatile moments. When disabled, fees remain flat regardless of market conditions.
definitions.protocolFee: Meteora takes a fixed 20% cut of all swap fees across every config. This is not configurable. You keep the remaining 80%.
